question: What protective role does Bagalā fulfill for those who surrender in the world?
premises: Bagalā is the refuge of all who have surrendered.
She is addressed as mother in the world.
She is the destroyer of sorrow.
inference: Bagalā protects surrendered beings in the world by serving as their refuge and removing their sorrow.
plain_english: O Mother Bagalā, refuge of all who have surrendered in the world, destroyer of sorrow.
